events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A game-changer for The Beatles and music as a whole. 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in '65, proving they were far from just a pop band.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of John Lennon's death in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist whose impact on music and culture remains immeasurable.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The Starman would be 80 today. Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie, a true innovator who constantly redefined music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King. Elvis Presley would have turned 92 today, his music still shaking up generations.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Rock royalty is 83 today! Happy birthday to the iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page, whose riffs continue to inspire.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Our House wouldn't be the same without him. Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Seventy-one today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and cultural icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous at 81! Happy birthday to the incomparable Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got that magic touch. Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring legends like The Beatles and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: The start of something legendary. It was on this day in '89 that the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony. Who was your favourite first inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Another Take That legend celebrating! Happy 55th birthday to the brilliant Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their impromptu rooftop concert. An unforgettable moment in music.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Against All Odds, he's 76! Happy birthday to the one and only Phil Collins.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got that charming twinkle. Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British rom-com star, Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for 'Only Fools and Horses', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: This day marks the tragic anniversary in 1959 when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. On this day in '59, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash, leaving an indelible mark on rock and roll history.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give up on turning 61! Happy birthday to the one and only Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, his message of peace and unity still resonating globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Tapestry of talent. Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King, a true songwriting legend.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic vocalist Whitney Houston in 2012.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation. Today marks the anniversary of Whitney Houston's passing, her incredible talent still shining bright.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That officially announced their split, much to the heartbreak of fans worldwide.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: The day hearts broke across the nation. It's been 31 years since Take That announced their original split. Thankfully, they're back and better than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and 68 years young! Happy birthday to the voice of UB40, Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: From busking to stadiums, he's still making waves. Happy 36th birthday to the incredibly talented Ed Sheeran.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and music of George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. His timeless songs continue to inspire.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey Birthday
angles.copy: Hope he gets a good feeling! Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary voice of The Who, Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop icon Nik Kershaw, known for hits like 'Wouldn't It Be Good', celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw Birthday
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to wish Nik Kershaw a happy 69th birthday? We certainly think so!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin Birthday
angles.copy: Half a century of making musical magic! Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman and rock icon Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi Birthday
angles.copy: Living on a prayer and turning 65! Happy birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Remembering singer-songwriter Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Driving Home For Christmas, and remembering the great Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. His distinctive voice lives on.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Remembering Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Mary Wilson Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Stop! In the name of love, and remember the iconic Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today. A true Motown legend.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk debut
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson famously debuted the Moonwalk during his performance of 'Billie Jean' at Motown 25.

angles.name: MJ Moonwalk Anniversary
angles.copy: The moment the world stopped and watched. On this day in '83, Michael Jackson unveiled the Moonwalk, changing dance forever.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Numan Birthday
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? We're certainly feeling good wishing Gary Numan a happy 69th birthday!
